In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the more mobile applications satisfy human needs, the more they are accepted by users.
the more a mobile application is perceived to enhance task performance and to be easy to use, the more users will continue to use it.
mobile application users are more likely to continue using an application when they perceive the application as easy to use and that it provides a variety of benefits.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the user friendliness and the social utility of the application should be considered as the key factors in the design of a mobile application.
mobile application users are not interested in the entertainment aspect, but are more interested in how easy and useful it is to use the application.
mobile applications should provide users with a sense of social connection and social utility, as well as entertainment and information seeking.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the mobile application vendors should focus on the ease of use of mobile apps.
the more useful and easy-to-use a mobile application is, the more likely it is to be used by its target audience.
mobile applications should be easy to use and should satisfy multiple purposes, including entertainment, information seeking, social connection, and performance enhancement.
